title: Policy & Terms Change Monitor input
description: Monitor public legal, policy, pricing, and service pages. The first run saves a baseline; later runs report meaningful changes.

pages.title: Pages to monitor
pages.description: Public HTTP(S) pages. Add a short label such as Terms, Privacy, DPA, SLA, Pricing, or Acceptable Use.

url.title: URL
url.description: Public page URL beginning with http:// or https://.

stateStoreName.title: Snapshot storage name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store used to keep baselines between runs. Use a different name for each independent monitor.

emitBaselines.title: Output first-run baselines
emitBaselines.description: Add a dataset item when a page is first recorded.

emitUnchanged.title: Output unchanged pages
emitUnchanged.description: Add a dataset item even when no meaningful change is detected.

ignoreSelectors.title: Additional CSS selectors to ignore
ignoreSelectors.description: Optional selectors for dynamic or irrelevant page regions, such as .last-updated-banner.

ignorePatterns.title: Text patterns to ignore
ignorePatterns.description: Optional case-insensitive regular expressions. Matching text blocks are excluded from snapshots.

webhookUrl.title: Change webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS endpoint that receives one JSON payload after meaningful changes are found.

webhookBearerToken.title: Webhook bearer token
webhookBearerToken.description: Optional bearer token sent in the Authorization header.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds allowed for each page request.

maxResponseBytes.title: Maximum page size
maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum response size accepted per page, in bytes.
